findings.evidence: `Braided/Balanced.lean:63`: `attribute [reassoc] twist_tensor`. The existing comment at lines 54-55 concerns only the Drinfeld tensor identity, not the twist step or the `unit` field.
findings.fix: Use `rw [Category.id_comp, BalancedCategory.twist_tensor_assoc]` (or `simp [BalancedCategory.twist_tensor_assoc]`). For `unit`, use `simp [drinfeldIso_unit_hom]` or a short `rw`. For the final step, use the reassociated Drinfeld lemma or `simp`. Where the double-dual mismatch really forces `Eq.trans`, add a comment saying so at that step.
findings.issue: The first `calc` step of `tensor` is a nested `Category.id_comp`/`congrArg`/`Category.assoc` chain that duplicates the existing `twist_tensor_assoc` and will break if Mathlib renames these lemmas. The `unit` field (lines 48-51) and the final `calc` step (lines 66-68, `(Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg ... tensorHom_comp_tensorHom)`) reassociate by hand in the same way.

findings.evidence: `pivotalIso_hom_app` (`Pivotal/Basic.lean:97`) is already in the `simp only` set, so the remaining gap is an undocumented instance or wrapper mismatch.
findings.fix: Close the goal with the named bridging lemma (e.g. `(pivotalIso_hom_app X).symm` under the instance `P`, or `Iso.ext`), or add a comment naming the unfolding the `rfl` performs.
findings.issue: `pivotalOfBalanced_balancedOfBraidedPivotal` ends with a bare `rfl` after `simp only`. It relies on two forms of the same morphism being equal by unfolding, with no comment saying which.

summary: Two proofs are hand-built from chains of `id_comp`, `congrArg` and `Category.assoc` even though `twist_tensor_assoc` already exists, and one round-trip proof ends with an uncommented `rfl` that relies on unfolding definitions.
